items.heading: Pad Thai
details: Key ingredients: rice noodles, shrimp or chicken, egg, tamarind, fish sauce, peanuts, bean sprouts
Soak flat rice noodles until pliable.
Stir-fry shrimp or chicken with egg in a hot wok.
Add noodles with a tamarind-fish sauce mixture, tossing to combine.
Finish with bean sprouts, crushed peanuts and a wedge of lime.

items.heading: Tom Yum Soup
details: Key ingredients: shrimp, lemongrass, galangal, kaffir lime leaves, chili, lime juice
Simmer lemongrass, galangal and kaffir lime leaves in stock to infuse.
Add shrimp or chicken and mushrooms, cooking until done.
Season with fish sauce, chili paste and lime juice for a hot-sour balance.
Serve hot, garnished with cilantro.

items.heading: Green Curry
details: Key ingredients: green curry paste, coconut milk, chicken, thai eggplant, basil
Fry green curry paste in a little coconut cream until fragrant.
Add chicken pieces and cook until sealed.
Pour in the rest of the coconut milk and simmer with eggplant.
Finish with torn thai basil leaves and serve with jasmine rice.

items.heading: Tom Yum
details: Ingredients: main ingredient, onion/garlic or other aromatics, oil or fat, salt, spices/herbs and water/stock as needed.
Prepare and cut the main ingredients.
Sauté or toast the aromatics and spices, add the main ingredients and cook using the traditional simmering, steaming, baking or grilling method until done.

items.heading: Massaman Curry
details: Ingredients: main vegetable/protein, onion, garlic, ginger, spices, tomato or coconut, oil and salt.
Sauté aromatics and spices, add the main ingredient and sauce base, simmer covered until cooked and the sauce thickens.
